our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes this a claim about revenue from renting AI computing capacity.

The plain reading is that a substantial share of customer payments could not continue without further external financing. Being unprofitable or having raised money does not alone establish that dependence.
The majority formulation is qualified. I do not turn it into a firm threshold above 50%.

criteria.support_condition: Revenue-weighted evidence shows that a substantial share of AI compute rental revenue in the target period depended on customers obtaining continuing venture funding or debt.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evidence shows that financing-dependent customers accounted for only a small share of the sector's revenue, with the remainder sustainably funded from customer operations or existing resources.
